summary.name: Songtide
summary.one_liner: A free native Mac app that wraps YouTube Music with synced lyrics, a 10-band equalizer, a visualizer, a menu bar mini player and desktop widgets.
use_cases: Play YouTube Music in a native Mac window
Follow along with synced song lyrics
Control music from the menu bar or media keys
Shape sound with an equalizer preset or custom curve
Show current song on Discord profile
summary.what_it_does: Songtide wraps YouTube Music in a native macOS app with a player bar, media keys and Control Center support, and a sidebar for Home, Explore, songs, albums, artists and playlists. A menu bar mini player keeps music playing when the window is closed. It offers a 10-band equalizer with presets like Bass Boost, Vocal and Late Night, plus a visualizer with hundreds of visuals. Synced lyrics from LRCLIB display in a floating window or over the visualizer. It also includes a Now Playing widget, Shortcuts actions, Last.fm scrobbling, Discord status, and support for 36 languages.
notable: Native Mac player bar with media keys, Control Center and menu bar mini player
Synced lyrics from LRCLIB, a free open lyrics database
Equalizer and visualizer that only capture Songtide's own playback, not other apps or the microphone
Installable via Homebrew cask; automatic signed updates
caveats: Without YouTube Music Premium, YouTube's ads play
Some songs have lyrics without timing
Sign-in is handled by Google; Last.fm and Discord are off until enabled
